project.title: Finite-Sample Certificates for Adaptive Stopping in Count-Exchangeable Binary Pass-Count Replay
project.paper_identity: Oracle true-H conditional replay theorem plus a distinct FIT-frozen fitted-score CAL-screened marginal replay guarantee; TEST is descriptive.

revision_scope.theorem_1: Oracle only: true H_star, count-exchangeable random-prefix replay, exact conditional identity/tower property.
revision_scope.bayes_h: Implemented plug-in score s_HhatFIT; only Theorem 2 is operational.
revision_scope.theorem_2: Independent i.i.d. FIT/CAL tasks, finite FIT-frozen J=64 family, bounded task loss, empirical-Bernstein UCB plus Bonferroni; selected-rule marginal replay guarantee.
revision_scope.test: One descriptive readout, not a second population guarantee.
revision_scope.figure_1: Code-native Matplotlib rendering from hash-pinned reviewer-package-local evidence JSON; legacy generated figure is historical-only.
revision_scope.formal_boundaries: Odd early budget is defined only on a nonempty feasible set; FULL-N is a separate deterministic fallback. The even-N center is proved separately, and an infeasible TV radius is a sentinel rather than numeric zero.
revision_scope.closest_work: A without-replacement confidence-sequence majority stopper is an unevaluated direct same-endpoint comparator; no efficiency separation is claimed.
